name.zh: 東清的女性長輩：退潮時只拿需要的
name.en: Iranmeylek woman elder: take only what you need at low tide

review: 東清潮間帶的採集規矩

steps.text: 東清的女性長輩帶你去潮間帶
steps.textEn: The Iranmeylek woman elder takes you to the tide flats

lines.zh: 退潮了，跟我來。潮間帶是大家的廚房，要留給明天，也要留給別人。
lines.en: Low tide. Come with me. The tide flats are everyone's kitchen. Leave some for tomorrow, and for others.

steps.text: 跟著長輩在潮間帶撿貝類、採海菜，太小的放回去
steps.textEn: Follow the elder on the tide flats picking shellfish and seaweed, putting the small ones back

lines.zh: 這個太小了，放回去，讓牠再長大。
lines.en: This one's too small. Put it back and let it grow.

lines.zh: 這個可以。夠吃就好，不要裝滿。
lines.en: That one's fine. Just enough to eat — don't fill up.

steps.text: 回到東清的女性長輩身邊
steps.textEn: Go back to the Iranmeylek woman elder

lines.zh: 今天就這些，剛剛好。潮水要回來了，我們上去吧。
lines.en: That's enough for today — just right. The tide is coming back. Let's go up.

hint.zh: 退潮時，東清的女性長輩會去潮間帶，可以跟她學怎麼採。
hint.en: At low tide, the Iranmeylek woman elder goes to the tide flats. You can learn from her how to pick.

name.zh: 東清的長輩：出海前的繩索與槳
name.en: Iranmeylek elder: ropes and paddles before going to sea

text.unlockEn: The Tao man's preparation for sea

steps.text: 東清的長輩要族男自己檢查一次
steps.textEn: The Iranmeylek elder wants the Tao man to check everything himself

lines.zh: 上次教你看，這次你自己來。繩子、槳，一樣一樣看。
lines.en: Last time I showed you. This time you do it. The ropes, the paddles — check them one by one.

steps.text: 族男到東清灣沙灘，把繩索拉直、檢查槳
steps.textEn: The Tao man goes to the Dongqing Bay beach, pulls the ropes straight and checks the paddles

lines.zh: 這段繩子磨得很薄了，要換。槳沒問題。
lines.en: This section of rope is worn very thin. It needs replacing. The paddles are fine.

lines.zh: 看得對。海上出事，常常是從一條小繩子開始的。
lines.en: You saw it right. Trouble at sea often starts with one small rope.

hint.zh: 飛魚季時，東清的長輩要族男自己檢查繩索與槳。
hint.en: In flying fish season, the Iranmeylek elder wants the Tao man to check the ropes and paddles himself.

name.zh: 東清的族人：清晨的海灣
name.en: Iranmeylek villager: the bay at dawn

steps.text: 東清的族人說起看日出的遊客
steps.textEn: An Iranmeylek villager talks about the sunrise tourists

lines.zh: 每天清晨，很多遊客來東清灣看日出。人多是好事，可是垃圾也多。
lines.en: Every morning, lots of tourists come to Dongqing Bay for the sunrise. More people is good, but there's more rubbish too.

lines.zh: 還有人坐到拼板舟上拍照……那是別人家的船啊。可以幫我一起去海灣看看嗎？
lines.en: And some sit in the plank boats for photos… those are other families' boats. Could you help me check on the bay?

steps.text: 到東清灣沙灘撿垃圾，客氣地請遊客離拼板舟遠一點
steps.textEn: Pick up rubbish on the Dongqing Bay beach and politely ask tourists to move away from the plank boats

lines.zh: 不好意思，這是族人的船，可以到旁邊拍嗎？謝謝！
lines.en: Excuse me, this is a Tao family's boat. Could you take your photo from the side? Thanks!

lines.zh: 撿起了寶特瓶和塑膠袋。
lines.en: Picked up plastic bottles and plastic bags.

lines.zh: 謝謝你們。我們不是不歡迎遊客，只是希望大家記得，這裡是有人住的地方。
lines.en: Thank you. It's not that we don't welcome tourists — we just hope people remember that people live here.

hint.zh: 東清的族人在煩惱清晨看日出的遊客，去問問他怎麼了。
hint.en: An Iranmeylek villager is worried about the sunrise tourists. Go ask him what's wrong.

name.zh: 東清的族人：回家的理由
name.en: Iranmeylek villager: reasons for coming home

steps.text: 晚上在東清，聽族人說他為什麼回到島上
steps.textEn: At night in Iranmeylek, hear a villager tell why he came back to the island

lines.zh: 我以前在臺北工作十幾年，每天坐捷運，看不到海。
lines.en: I worked in Taipei for over ten years. I took the metro every day and never saw the sea.

lines.zh: 後來阿爸身體不好，我就回來了。現在開民宿、帶導覽，也跟長輩學出海。
lines.en: Then Dad's health got worse, so I came back. Now I run a guesthouse, lead tours, and learn to go to sea with the elders.

lines.zh: 年輕人回來不容易，工作少。可是你看這片海，晚上這麼安靜，我就知道我選對了。
lines.en: It's not easy for young people to come back. There's little work. But look at this sea, so quiet at night — I know I made the right choice.

hint.zh: 晚上東清的族人常在灣邊乘涼。
hint.en: At night, Iranmeylek villagers often relax by the bay.
